The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's replanning at step 31. It turned the single Tales of a Mountain Mama article into the candidate pool and dropped the requirement to gather recommendations from at least three different people with kids. The new plan also told the team to check TripAdvisor "only for the identified hikes from a single source." That locked the search onto one author's list, which omitted correct answers such as Artist Point, Fountain Paint Pot, and Storm Point Trail. Every later step only verified ratings for that narrowed list, so the final answer could not recover.
